LESSON: READING 14.4.1 FEATURES OF STYLE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Reading 14.4.1 Features of style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 14.4.1 Features of style. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: where dialogues, similes, and metaphors can be used. Why do we use stylistic devices in writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify instances of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in the text
2. use the styles of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in guided context
3. appreciate the importance of style in a work of art

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 14.4.1 FEATURES OF STYLE
This lesson teaches Reading 14.4.1 Features of style for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify instances of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in the text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the styles of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in guided context
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of style in a work of art
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 14.4.1 Features of style using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 14.4.1 Features of style above.
2. Explain Reading 14.4.1 Features of style to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 14.4.1 Features of style.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 14.4.1 Features of style with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 14.4.1 Features of style important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. where dialogues, similes, and metaphors can be used. Why do we use stylistic devices in writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify instances of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in the text
2. use the styles of dialogue, similes, and metaphors in guided context
3. appreciate the importance of style in a work of art
